title: Recursive wildcards cross component and hidden-file boundaries
prompt: Recursive glob matching violates component boundaries and hidden-file settings. '**/.*' should match '.abc' and 'abc/.abc', but must not match 'ab.c' or 'abc/ab.c'. When require_literal_leading_dot is enabled, '**/*' must not match '.cache' or descend through 'dir/.cache/file'. Fix these inconsistencies while preserving explicitly requested hidden names, the option-off behavior, Unicode path components, recursive empty matches, and literal separator requirements. Add regression coverage and keep the registered portable suite passing.

hardness.rule_registered_before_comparative_runs: >=20 meaningful changed production lines across >=2 functions, OR >=40 meaningful stateful-algorithm lines and >=3 edge-case families
hardness.count_method: Added plus removed nonblank production lines containing an identifier or digit, excluding comment-only lines and pure punctuation; original upstream production diff, excluding test modules. This is a structural proxy, not observed solver difficulty.
edge_case_families: full component boundaries versus suffixes within a component
hidden components at the root and below visible directories
separator policy, explicit hidden names, and multibyte components

setup.dependency_lock: Upstream Cargo.lock, copied unchanged to the registered source; historical dev dependencies fetched once before all checks
setup.target_isolation: Distinct Cargo target per exported source; delete own build products after each trial/evaluation stage, retaining frozen source and receipts

evaluation.inline_test_handling: Restore the registered EOF #[cfg(test)] mod test suffix including the portability fixture

compatibility.purpose: Replace the /root directory and access-control assumption in test_iteration_errors with a private temporary unreadable directory; same permission-denied assertions, no skips, no production changes
